constraints.constraint: Header-Only Configuration: Every configurable value MUST be defined in a header file. No magic numbers in source code. - GPIO pins: Use MCP1_X_INPOS, never 8 - Commands: Use CMD_INPOS, never "INPOS" - Errors: Use ERR_INVALID_AXIS, never "E002"
Dual-Core Separation: Core 0 handles communication and safety monitoring, Core 1 handles motion control. ServoFeedbackReader runs in safety_monitor context on Core 0.

InPos Pin Mapping: - MCP1_X_INPOS = 8 (GPB0) - MCP1_Y_INPOS = 9 (GPB1) - MCP1_Z_INPOS = 10 (GPB2) - MCP1_A_INPOS = 11 (GPB3) - MCP1_B_INPOS = 12 (GPB4) Servo axes only: X,Y,Z,A,B. Steppers C,D,E have no InPos.
MCP23017 #1 Port B is shared: - GPB0-4: InPos signals (this story) - GPB5-7: Spare digital inputs (Story 4.7) Use mcp23017_wrapper mutex for thread-safe access.
This story implements BASIC InPos reading only (FR37 partial). Advanced InPos processing (motion confirmation, timeout) is Epic 6 Story 6.5.
